title: FIVE NIGHTS AT FREDDY'S MOD (Classic)
description: Classic FNaF mod featuring animatronic mobs and poseable statues, re-uploaded for players to experience the original version.
body:
# [1.7.10] Five Nights at Freddy’s Mod

This is the classic **Five Nights at Freddy’s Mod** for Minecraft 1.7.10. It brings the terrifying experience of the original game into the world of Minecraft, complete with custom AI and survival mechanics that will keep you on edge.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/nBg8GH5SdK4" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

### Gameplay Mechanics

The mod features custom AI that makes the animatronics behave exactly like in the original game:

* **Stalking Mechanic:** They stay completely still while you’re looking at them. But the moment you turn away? That’s when they move.
* **Detection:** They will stalk you from over 50 blocks away. Even if you hide behind a wall, if you aren't directly looking at them, they will keep creeping toward you.
* **The "Jumpscare":** If they manage to sneak up on you or get too close, they’ll **GRAB** you. Your screen will fill with static and slowly fade to darkness.
* **Survival:** If you're quick, you can walk away to break free from the static. But if you’re too slow and the screen goes black... **it’s game over.**

---

### About This Upload

This is a **preservation upload**. The original mod was created years ago (by [Cody Owen for The Atlantic Craft/Voidswrath](https://www.youtube.com/@TheAtlanticCraft)) and was eventually abandoned.

I’ve re-hosted this for the community so new players can experience it exactly as it was. **No code, models, or features have been altered.** I simply extracted the clean `.jar` file from the old, bloated auto-installer to make it easy for you to drop into your `mods` folder.

---

### Main Features

* **Classic FNaF Mobs:** Face off against the original animatronics.
* **Custom AI:** Sophisticated movement system that tracks when you aren't looking.
* **Tense Survival:** Try to avoid the dreaded jumpscare static!
* **Decoration:** Includes poseable statues for your own custom horror maps or builds.

---

### ⚙️ Requirements

* **Minecraft:** 1.7.10
* **Forge Modloader:** 1.7.10 compatible
* **Java:** Version 8

---

### ⚠️ Important Notes

* **Version Lock:** This is strictly for 1.7.10. It will not work on newer versions of Minecraft.
* **Backup Your World:** Since this is a legacy mod, always make a backup of your world before installing.
* **Compatibility:** This is the original version, so keep in mind that it comes with all the classic bugs and behaviors from 2015/2016.

---

### Credits & Info

* **Original Developer:** Cody Owen (The Atlantic Craft / Voidswrath).
* **This Upload:** Cleaned and optimized for easy manual installation.
* **Original File Path:** Extracted from: `https://voidswrath.com/mods/1-7-10-five-nights-at-freddys-mod/`
